study_identification_part.si_4_title: Hippocampal-amygdalo-ventricular atrophy score: Alzheimer disease detection using normative and pathological lifespan models

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: Training datasets: C-MIND (multi-site), NDAR (includes NIHPD data), ABIDE, ICBM (multi-site), IXI, OASIS (OASIS-1 cross-sectional), and ADNI. Testing datasets: AIBL, MIRIAD, and ADNI (MCI subjects).
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: Our training dataset was composed of 3,032 T1-weighted (T1w) MRI from seven open access databases (Table 1). This dataset was composed of 2,655 CN subjects (CN) and 377 patients with AD. ... To validate our model, we built a testing dataset based on two open access databases (AIBL and MIRIAD) ... In addition, we used subjects with mild cognitive impairment (MCI) from ADNI.

answer.OASIS-1: normative training and AD training for lifespan models

answer.ADNI: normative training, AD training, and testing (prognosis MCI)

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: Healthy control (CN) subjects from 7 databases (C-MIND, NDAR, ABIDE, ICBM, IXI, OASIS, ADNI) were used to estimate CN lifespan trajectories. AD patients from OASIS and ADNI, along with young CN subjects (<55y), were used to estimate AD trajectories. External validation for AD detection was performed on AIBL and MIRIAD, while prognosis capability was tested on ADNI MCI subjects (sMCI vs pMCI).
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: For CN trajectories, we used the N = 2,655 subjects ... of the training dataset ... For the AD trajectories, we used N = 2,251 subjects. ... we mixed AD patients with young CN. ... To validate our model, we built a testing dataset based on two open access databases (AIBL and MIRIAD) to perform AD versus CN diagnosis task. ... we used subjects with mild cognitive impairment (MCI) from ADNI to estimate the capability of our models on prognosis task.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.location: Coupe2022.pdf.md: 2.1.1 Training dataset, 2.1.2 Testing dataset, 2.4 Lifespan model estimation

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: The normative lifespan model was trained on 2,655 CN subjects from 7 databases. External validation included 467 CN from AIBL and 23 CN from MIRIAD, totaling 3,145 HC subjects across the study phases. The AD lifespan model used a subset of these HC (N=1,874 younger than 55y) but is considered a pathological model.
